name: TC-462: a COMPED order goes to print with nothing charged — and minting the card batch is what fulfilment does
description: On-behalf COMP → proof → Fulfil (no price section, 'Comped — nothing is charged.', button reads 'Place with vendor') → IN_PRODUCTION with total 0 and paidAt set, a GiftCardBatch on the order, the 'on us' email, and Finance's comped cost up by the vendor cost.
